label: Getting from one place to another: how you travel there or how far/long the trip is. Fires on the mode of travel (by bus, on foot, ride a bike to work, a drive away), on travel time to a place (twenty minutes from the centre), and on the converted figure of a distance between places (e.g. 30 km (19 miles) north of). A bare distance with no travel mode or conversion is weaker (about 0.2). Quiet for measurements that are not trips (weight, width, depth, cooking times) and for 'distance' or 'way' used figuratively.
